plan.explanation: Sequence starts with establishing the datum face F1 on M1. Through-hole F2 and pocket F3 are machined concurrently or sequentially after F1 (order flexible, placed before reaming). Hole F4 requires drilling then reaming; drilling must precede reaming. Final hole F5 is drilled. All operations use compatible tools on Machine 1 which supports all required operations.
assumptions: All features are machined in a single setup or rapid setups assumed without penalty for simplicity.
Tool compatibility rules from catalogue are strictly followed (drill type T4/T5 for drilling, reamer T6 for reaming).
uncertainties: Actual tool approach vectors and collision avoidance are not modelled.
Clamping strategy for simultaneous machining of F3 pocket while other holes are present is not verified.

plan.explanation: Sequence starts with establishing the datum face F1 on M1. Through-hole F2 and pocket F3 are machined concurrently or sequentially after F1 (order flexible, placed before reaming). Hole F4 is drilled then reamed on separate machines (M1 for drilling, M3 for reaming); drilling must precede reaming. Final hole F5 is drilled. All operations use compatible tools on capable machines.
assumptions: All features are machined in a single setup or rapid setups assumed without penalty for simplicity.
Tool compatibility rules from catalogue are strictly followed (drill type T4/T5 for drilling, reamer T6 for reaming).
Machine M3 is available and capable of performing the reaming operation after the drilling on M1.
uncertainties: Actual tool approach vectors and collision avoidance are not modelled.
Clamping strategy for simultaneous machining of F3 pocket while other holes are present is not verified.
Inter-machine setup times or transfer logistics between M1 and M3 are not accounted for.
